content_metadata.description: The video follows the narrator, an avid metal detector enthusiast, as he explores Durant Park in search of hidden treasures. Throughout the journey, he discovers various items, emphasizing the thrill of exploring the past and the importance of persistence in metal detecting.

qAndA.answer: The narrator found a 1963 Kennedy half dollar.
qAndA.question: What type of coin did the narrator find at the base of the tree, along with the nickel?

qAndA.answer: The narrator noticed that his metal detector was reacting to some of the trees, suggesting they might have absorbed metal at some point in their growth.
qAndA.question: What unusual phenomenon does the narrator observe and discuss with viewers while walking through the park?

qAndA.answer: He described it as the 'faintest signal ever,' indicating that he almost missed it entirely.
qAndA.question: How does the narrator describe the signal he received from the 1893 Barber dime?

qAndA.answer: He expresses extreme excitement, amazement, and disbelief, stating that he is 'freaking out.'
qAndA.question: What emotions does the narrator display after finding the Barber dime?

qAndA.answer: It demonstrates his dedication, patience, and unwavering belief that valuable discoveries are possible even amidst a lot of junk.
qAndA.question: What does the narrator's persistence in digging up common items like nails and pull tabs reveal about his approach to metal detecting?

youtube_description:
Hello again everyone! As the metal detecting season winds down here in Michigan, I have been trying to get out as much as possible in order to find what I can before winter sets in. On this episode, I explore Durant Park, which lies in the center of Lansing. Dating back to 1921, the location has seen over 100 years of local history. One of the first "planned" parks in Lansing, much of the landscaping and architecture remains the same. I discover a HUGE bucket-lister on this episode, something that I thought I would never find... 

Subscribe to my YouTube channel! https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCT2Z...

Filmed in Michigan.

Camera used: Apple iPhone 7 Plus
Detector Used: Garrett ACE250
Pinpointed Used: Deteknix 

Want to see more? Here are some of my other recent videos!

https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCT2Z...
